title: The self-update stub checks, applies, and relaunches on the new version; a broken version reverts to last-good
binding: Both legs run through a leg-private Puck.Launcher.Stub install: the positive leg's first boot signs a throwaway 2.0.0 release, runs update.check/update.apply against it, and its second boot observes the stub launch the applied version; the discriminating leg pre-stages a 2.0.0 with no executable at all, so its first boot observes the stub refuse to launch it and its second boot observes the generation-safe revert to the pre-existing 1.0.0.

expect.name: the pointer ends on the applied version
the broken version refuses to launch
the pointer reverts to the last-good version
